name: wildroot
description: A grounded identity for regenerative gardening tools. Branching roots, mulberry soil tones, and softly rustic type honor the untidy beauty of things that grow.
heading: fraunces
rules: The branching root symbol always has a visible central stem.
Allow branches to frame content without crossing body text.
Use husk for instructional pages and wild grass for packaging.

system.concept: Branching line studies, carved seedpod illustrations, soil-colored labels, and a softly rustic serif. The useful grid leaves room for a little natural wildness.
headline: Good things grow
a little wild.
system.productNote: Useful things for an untidy kind of beauty.
features: A practical approach that begins with the ground beneath you.
Considered garden tools with a clear place in the everyday.
A little care, a little patience, and some space for the unexpected.
system.layoutNote: Husk split hero with soil serif type and branching artwork. Grass image panels, seedpod annotation chips, and an orderly instructional grid underneath.
